title: Capri RV Resort

services.name: Acorn Campground
services.desc: The 283-acre Bend-Sunriver RV Camping preserve, on the Little Deschutes River, offers the best of both worlds: warm summers and snowy, dry winters. Fishing is allowed on this Central Oregon RV campground and preserve, and rivers and lakes in the area offer salmon, whitefish, and rainbow trout. Other summer fun includes boating, swimming, hiking and horseback riding. Our Thousand Trails resort offers both canoe and kayak rentals. Campsites, cabins, cottages, and yurts are available. Mt. Bachelor, a world-class ski resort just minutes away from Bend-Sunriver RV Camping, provides many winter activities as well as summer hiking and mountain biking. services.name: Cabins & Rentals
services.desc: A cozy rental option, our cabins sleep up to 6 people. They offer clean, open floor plans that feature full bathrooms, TVs, dinettes, kitchenettes equipped with a full-sized refrigerator, coffee maker, and a toaster or toaster oven. Outside, enjoy sitting on the cozy front porch, many of which also have a gas grill! Hoping to rough it a bit? We also have more rustic options available, conveniently located near a bathhouse. Cabins can be found at more locations, check out our rental search to see them all! Ask how you can camp all year long with our Thousand Trails Camping Pass! Our Thousand Trails memberships are offered by MHC Thousand Trails Limited Partnership, Two North Riverside Plaza,

blurb: Located near the center of Yuma, Arizona, Capri RV Resort is an age-qualified RV community that offers a quiet yet active facility year-round. Even during the winter months, Yuma's temperatures are moderate and comfortable. Visitors to this Encore Yuma RV resort will find a very active community that will keep you busy during your stay, with both relaxing or exciting activities to suit your needs.
